JournalEntry.title: JournalEntry
JournalEntry.description: A user-authored journal reflection with multi-turn Gemini AI interaction history and summaries.

id.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this journal entry

title.description: Title or headline of the reflection

content.description: The initial or primary reflection text written by the user

turns.description: Multi-turn conversation history between the user and Gemini

summary.description: AI-generated summary or core themes of the reflection

tags.description: User or AI categorized tags for reflection

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the entry was created

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the entry was last updated

/users/{userId}/entries/{entryId}.description: Stores private journal reflections and multi-turn Gemini interactions isolated strictly to the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/interactions/{interactio.description: Stores isolated interaction logs strictly bound to the authenticated user.
